citation.authors: Norouzzadeh M, Hasan Rashedi M, Azizi MH, Teymoori F et al

cited_by.title: Hibiscus (sorrel, zobo, bissap) and blood pressure

record.population: 1,797 people across 26 randomised trials (Iran, Mexico, Egypt, Nigeria and others)
record.design: Umbrella review of meta-analyses plus updated dose-response meta-analysis, graded with GRADE and credibility tools
record.finding: Hibiscus lowered systolic and diastolic pressure compared with placebo and other teas, dose-dependently, with no significant difference from antihypertensive drugs. The authors rated the credibility of a fall of more than 10 mmHg as moderate. The authors note long-term and therapeutic-dose safety needs monitoring.
